items.source: Redis connections, unlike perhaps their underlying native connection are not Thread-safe and should not be shared across multiple threads.
items.translation: 与底层的原生连接可能不同，Redis 连接并非线程安全的，不应在多个线程之间共享。

items.source:
Execute the given command for the key provided potentially appending args.
This method, other than RedisCommands.execute(String, byte[]...), dispatches the command to the key serving master node. 

// SET foo bar EX 10 NX
execute("SET", "foo".getBytes(), asBinaryList("bar", "EX", 10, "NX"))
items.translation:
执行给定命令，针对提供的 key，并可能附加参数。
此方法（不同于 RedisCommands.execute(String, byte[]...)）会将命令分发到为 key 服务的 master 节点。 

// SET foo bar EX 10 NX
execute("SET", "foo".getBytes(), asBinaryList("bar", "EX", 10, "NX"))

items.source: Execute the given command for the key provided potentially appending args.
items.translation: 为提供的key执行给定命令，并可能附加参数。

items.source: null when no keys stored at node or when used in pipeline / transaction.
items.translation: 当节点中未存储任何键，或在管道/事务中使用该值时返回 null。

items.source: command result as delivered by the underlying Redis driver. Can be null.
items.translation: 底层 Redis 驱动程序返回的命令结果。可为 null。

items.source: RedisClusterConnection allows sending commands to dedicated nodes within the cluster. A RedisClusterNode can be obtained from RedisClusterCommands.clusterGetNodes() or it can be constructed using either host and RedisNode.getPort() or the node Id.
items.translation: RedisClusterConnection 允许向集群中的专用节点发送命令。可以通过 RedisClusterCommands.clusterGetNodes() 获取 RedisClusterNode，或者使用 host 和 RedisNode.getPort() 或 node Id 来构造它。
